name: H P Electronics
old_description: Joe has been working professionally with audio, video and related systems since 1988. Starting as a guitar accessory salesman at a large Musical Instrument Retailer, Joe advanced to become the Department Head of the Drum Section and then the Pro Sound Division. This experience led him in 1998 to HP Electronics, Inc. and the installation side of Audio and Video, where he has learned the sophisticated needs and techniques of designing and implementing professional, commercial grade AV. As a working musician, sound person and project studio owner, Joe understands the aspects of theater and house of worship presentations beyond his design and installation work at HP, offering additional guidance to his clients. Outside of work and music, Joe enjoys sports, especially baseball and hockey, the outdoors and spending time with his wife and 2 kids.
about:
HP Electronics, Inc. was founded in 1983 in Baltimore, Maryland, and operates as a licensed electrical contractor specializing in low-voltage electronic systems, distribution sub-systems, and fiber-optic transport media. The company serves the Maryland and Washington, D.C. region while maintaining a client base that extends nationwide and overseas.

The firm designs, installs, and services professional audio-visual and communication systems. Its service portfolio includes area-of-rescue emergency communication, audio system design and installation, classroom AV systems, synchronized clock and timekeeping networks, control system integration, digital signage, and intercom and paging systems. HP Electronics also provides low-voltage electrical contracting and fiber-optic infrastructure installation. The company has completed projects such as the New Severn Run High School auditorium and stadium, and the Church of the Resurrection.

HP Electronics serves education, healthcare, corporate and commercial, hospitality, government and public sector, entertainment and performance venues, houses of worship, and retail clients. Notable installations include projects for New Severn Run High School and the Church of the Resurrection, demonstrating expertise in educational and worship environments.

The company attributes its growth to a corporate philosophy that makes client satisfaction the most important product it delivers, citing that over 75 percent of new business comes from referrals. Early international work included designing and installing one of the first modern sound systems in mainland China, and the firm aims to be the most sought-after electronic systems contractor in the industry.
